$comment: Where motion data comes from: one entry per source, cited in full. See references/README.md. Research behind each entry: docs/research/motion-references.md.

muybridge-1887-catalogue.title: Animal Locomotion: Prospectus and Catalogue of Plates
muybridge-1887-catalogue.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-catalogue.rights: Published 1887. Internet Archive copy: "There are no known copyright restrictions in the United States on the use of the text."
muybridge-1887-catalogue.notes: Per plate: views, frames, fraction of a cycle and the interval between exposures in ms ("as recorded by a chronograph with a tuning-fork making 100 single vibrations in a second").

muybridge-1887-pl706.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 706 (Dog; trotting; interrupted; mastiff. Smith)
muybridge-1887-pl706.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl706.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl706.frames: 12 lateral only, 2 rows x 6, numbered 1-12 left to right (numbers handwritten bottom left of each frame), dog facing right; each frame from a different camera, so the background markers (52.6 px apart in the full scan) shift between frames

muybridge-1887-pl755.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 755 (Pigeon; flying)
muybridge-1887-pl755.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl755.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl755.frames: row 1: 12 lateral, numbered 12 to 1 left to right (handwritten numbers bottom right of each frame), so time runs right to left; pigeon facing left; rows 2-3: 12 front views (6 + 6). Each lateral frame from a different camera; the backdrop grid lines (thick lines about 228 px apart vertically) sit within 10 px of the same scan height in every frame.

marey-1883-heron.title: Chronophotograph of a Flying Heron
marey-1883-heron.creator: Étienne-Jules Marey
marey-1883-heron.holder: Cleveland Museum of Art, Dudley P. Allen Fund
marey-1883-heron.frames: about 12 overlapping positions on one plate, flying left to right; exposure rate unknown (silhouettes, not timing)

marey-1890-vol.title: Physiologie du mouvement : le vol des oiseaux
marey-1890-vol.creator: Étienne-Jules Marey
marey-1890-vol.notes: p. 100 §69 wingbeats per second (duck 9, pigeon 8); p. 24 §20 gull 3½ in level flight, about 5 at take-off.

maes-2008.title: Steady locomotion in dogs: temporal and associated spatial coordination patterns and the effect of speed
maes-2008.creator: Maes L.D., Herbin M., Hackert R., Bels V.L., Abourachid A.
maes-2008.rights: © The Company of Biologists 2008. Free to read; only measured values are used, no text or figures.

muybridge-1887-pl001.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl001.frames: 3 rows x 12: lateral (top), front, rear; numbered 1-12 left to right (numbers handwritten bottom left), model facing right

muybridge-1887-pl013.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl013.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl013.frames: 3 rows x 12: lateral (top), front, rear; numbered 1-12 left to right (numbers handwritten bottom left), model facing right

muybridge-1887-pl060.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 60 (Running at a half mile gait (shoes))
muybridge-1887-pl060.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl060.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl060.frames: 10 lateral (2 rows x 5, numbered 1-10 left to right, handwritten numbers bottom left, runner facing right) above a row of 10 front views; each lateral frame from a different camera

muybridge-1887-pl062.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 62 (Running full speed)
muybridge-1887-pl062.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl062.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl062.frames: 12 lateral (2 rows x 6, numbered 1-12 left to right, handwritten numbers bottom right, runner facing right) above a row of 12 rear views; each lateral frame from a different camera

muybridge-1887-pl064.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 64 (Running full speed)
muybridge-1887-pl064.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl064.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl064.frames: 12 lateral (2 rows x 6, numbered 1-12 left to right, handwritten numbers bottom left, runner facing right) above a row of 12 rear views; each lateral frame from a different camera

muybridge-1887-pl088.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 88 (Ascending stairs)
muybridge-1887-pl088.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl088.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl088.frames: 3 rows x 11: lateral (top), front (middle), rear (bottom); numbered 1-11 left to right (numbers handwritten bottom right of each frame); climber facing and moving right up a flight of box steps; the lateral frames share a common vertical scale (the step treads sit at the same y in every frame they appear in)

muybridge-1887-pl109.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 109 (Ascending step-ladder)
muybridge-1887-pl109.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl109.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl109.frames: 12 lateral (top row) + 12 rear (bottom row), numbered 1-12 left to right (numbers handwritten bottom left of each frame), climber facing and moving right onto a steep wooden step-ladder; frames about 250 px wide in the full scan; the lateral frames share a common vertical scale (the ladder treads sit at the same y in each frame)

muybridge-1887-pl111.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 111 (Ascending ladder)
muybridge-1887-pl111.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl111.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl111.frames: 11 rear (TOP row) + 11 lateral (BOTTOM row), numbered 1-11 left to right (numbers handwritten bottom left of each frame; frames 5 and 6 of the lateral row carry extra marks next to the number); climber faces LEFT, climbing a ladder that leans to the left; lateral frames about 290 px wide; a double interval between frames 5 and 6 (catalogue)

muybridge-1887-pl152.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 152 (Jumping; running straight high jump (shoes))
muybridge-1887-pl152.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl152.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl152.frames: 12 lateral (top row) + 12 front (bottom row), numbered 1-12 left to right (numbers handwritten bottom left of each frame), jumper facing and moving right over a bar between two posts (posts in frames 3-9); lateral frames about 300-320 px wide in the full scan; the figure is small (leg about 195 px)

muybridge-1887-pl159.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 159 (Jumping; running broad jump (shoes))
muybridge-1887-pl159.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl159.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl159.frames: 12 lateral (top row) + 12 front (bottom row), numbered 1-12 left to right (numbers handwritten bottom left of each frame), jumper facing and moving right; lateral frames about 300 px wide in the full scan; frames 11-12 are dim (landing in a pit, partly hidden)

muybridge-1887-pl161.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 161 (Jumping; standing high jump)
muybridge-1887-pl161.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl161.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl161.frames: 12 lateral (top row) + 12 rear-oblique (bottom row), numbered 1-12 left to right (numbers handwritten bottom left of each frame), jumper facing and moving right over a string between two posts; frame widths differ (about 240-350 px in the full scan); a landing mat lies under frames 9-12, and in frames 11-12 the jumper has turned his back toward the lateral camera

muybridge-1887-pl162.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 162 (Jumping; standing broad jump)
muybridge-1887-pl162.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl162.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl162.frames: 12 lateral (top row) + 12 rear-oblique (bottom row), numbered 1-12 left to right (numbers handwritten bottom left of each frame), jumper facing and moving right; frame widths differ (about 240-400 px in the full scan) and the figure's scale differs a little between frames; a landing mat lies under frames 9-12

muybridge-1887-pl236.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl236.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl236.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 236 (Placing chair and sitting down)
muybridge-1887-pl236.frames: 12 lateral (top row) + 12 front (bottom row), 1 row x 12 each; lateral frames numbered 1-12 RIGHT to LEFT (handwritten numbers bottom left of each frame; frame 1 is the rightmost), man (model 31) facing left; each frame from a different camera

muybridge-1887-pl249.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl249.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl249.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 249 (Rising from chair)
muybridge-1887-pl249.frames: 10 front (top row) + 10 lateral (bottom row); lateral frames numbered 1-10 left to right (handwritten numbers bottom left of each frame), man (model 31) facing right, turning away from the camera from frame 7; each frame from a different camera

muybridge-1887-pl707.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 707 (Dog; galloping; interrupted; mastiff. Dread)
muybridge-1887-pl707.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl707.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl707.frames: 8 lateral (2 rows x 4, numbered 1-8 left to right, numbers handwritten bottom left) then 1 row x 8 rear views; dog facing right; each frame from a different camera, so background markers shift between frames
muybridge-1887-pl707.intervalNote: The catalogue records no interval between exposures for this plate.

muybridge-1887-pl708.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 708 (Dog; galloping; brown racing hound. Ike)
muybridge-1887-pl708.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl708.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl708.frames: 10 lateral (2 rows x 5, numbered 1-10 left to right, numbers handwritten bottom left) then 1 row x 10 rear views; dog facing right; each frame from a different camera, so background markers shift between frames

muybridge-1887-pl709.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 709 (Dog; galloping; white racing hound. Maggie)
muybridge-1887-pl709.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl709.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl709.frames: 12 lateral (2 rows x 6, numbered 1-12 left to right, numbers handwritten bottom left) then 1 row x 12 rear views; dog facing right; each frame from a different camera, so background markers shift between frames

muybridge-1887-pl710.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 710 (Dog; galloping; white racing hound. Maggie)
muybridge-1887-pl710.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl710.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl710.frames: 12 lateral (2 rows x 6, numbered 1-12 left to right, numbers handwritten bottom right) then 1 row x 12 rear views; dog facing right; each frame from a different camera, so background markers shift between frames

muybridge-1887-pl765.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 765 (Vulture; flying)
muybridge-1887-pl765.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl765.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl765.frames: 24 lateral only, 4 rows x 6, numbered 1-24 left to right and top to bottom (handwritten numbers bottom left of each frame); vulture facing right. Each frame from a different camera; the backdrop grid has heavier lines about 146 px apart.

muybridge-1887-pl768.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 768 (Vulture; flying)
muybridge-1887-pl768.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl768.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl768.frames: row 1: 12 lateral, numbered 1-12 left to right (handwritten numbers at the bottom of each frame), vulture facing right; rows 2-3: 12 rear views (6 + 6), numbered 1-12. Lateral frames are small (about 300 x 360 px).

muybridge-1887-pl772.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 772 (Ostrich; walking)
muybridge-1887-pl772.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl772.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl772.frames: rows 1-2: 12 lateral, numbered 1-12 left to right (handwritten numbers bottom left of each frame), ostrich walking to the right; rows 3-4: 12 rear views. Each frame from a different camera.

muybridge-1887-pl756.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 756 (Pigeon; flying)
muybridge-1887-pl756.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl756.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl756.frames: row 1: 12 lateral, numbered 12 to 1 left to right (handwritten numbers bottom right of each frame), so time runs right to left; pigeon facing left; row 2: 12 front views. Each lateral frame from a different camera; the thick horizontal backdrop line sits at 1541-1549 px in every lateral frame.

muybridge-1887-pl757.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 757 (Pigeon; flying)
muybridge-1887-pl757.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl757.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl757.frames: rows 1-2: 12 lateral, numbered 1-6 and 7-12 left to right (handwritten numbers bottom left of each frame); pigeon facing right; rows 3-4: 12 rear views. Thick horizontal backdrop lines at about 941/1191 px (row 1) and 1430/1680 px (row 2).

muybridge-1887-pl758.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 758 (Cockatoo; flying)
muybridge-1887-pl758.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl758.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl758.frames: 3 rows of 8 lateral frames, numbered 1-24 left to right and top to bottom (handwritten numbers bottom left of each frame); cockatoo (white) facing right on a dark backdrop with a grid; the rows differ in backdrop and exposure.

muybridge-1887-pl774.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 774 (Adjutant; walking)
muybridge-1887-pl774.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl774.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl774.frames: 3 rows of 4 lateral frames, numbered 1-12 left to right and top to bottom (handwritten numbers bottom left of each frame); adjutant facing right in front of a vertical-bar fence; each frame from a different camera.
